faq: Do I need lifting experience?
Share your current experience with the gym team. The program conversation can start with learning the basics or with reviewing an existing routine.
Is one-to-one coaching included?
Personal training is a separate program. Elite membership includes four personal training sessions per month; you can compare the existing plans or ask about individual guidance.
How do I enquire about this program?
Use the enquiry button on this page. Strength Training will already be selected in the Contact form, where you can add your goals or questions.

Talk about your current experience and preferences with the team before choosing a starting point. The aim is to find a suitable direction for your training.
Can I combine cardio with strength training?
You can discuss a mix of activities with the gym team. The program and membership pages show the available directions and existing class inclusions.
Which plan includes group classes?
Basic includes two group classes per month. Pro and Elite include unlimited group classes. Confirm the activities available through your chosen plan with the gym.

Is personal training part of Elite?

Can I discuss a specific training goal?
Yes. Add your goal to the optional message in your enquiry draft so you have a clear starting point for a conversation with the gym.
